purpose: Select useful-work levels on outcome-blind current-rule exogenous legal percept workload; no gameplay benefit evidence
mindSnapshot: empty/null reset for every independent fixture and trial; learning active within each 4.125s exogenous clip
decisionScope: Common interface.act on 30Hz decision-bearing120Hz calls, including sensor filtering/queue, native act, common noise and final-command commit; excludes exogenous fixture construction, later diagnostics and stdout
cpuScope: process.cpuUsage around decision act, includes timing-call overhead and process background threads; serial subprocesses
selection: Mean over equally weighted fixture/trial measured decision wall times; select lowest useful level attaining ratio >=2 or >=4 respectively. If unattained choose highest level and explicitly mark target not attained. No extrapolation/time padding.
duplicateLevelPolicy: Keep both requested labels and disclose identical selected level if tie/nearest yields same level
failurePolicy: Preserve all raw; timeout or source mismatch blocks valid calibration, no favorable repeats
releasePolicy: Hash-bound PASS independent review and VERIFIED Git publication receipts, both binding exact sourceFingerprint and all six calibration source/plan/test hashes; exact manifest bytes hash and imported src/interface/package closure required; explicit CALIBRATION_ONLY_RELEASED + allowCalibration true. Training execution separate.
interpretation: Workload-specific timing ratios only. Actual training/evaluation gameplay timing ratios must also be reported; never equal-total-compute claim
controllerOrder: Deterministic partial Latin rotation of listed controllers; offsets per trial [0,2,4,6,1], same fixture order within controller. Five trials cannot fully balance eight positions; residual drift limitation retained.
workloadNature: Yoked exogenous legal percept snapshots, advancing time and visibility, not natural play; emitted commands do not alter later percepts. Log emitted command, perceived own spear state, mind situation/tier/branches and planner counts. Do not infer gameplay representativeness.
setupScope: Controller and wrapper construction wall/CPU measured separately per fixture before warmup; not added to per-decision ratio
telemetry: Current receipt versus actually delivered tick-18 own-spear state distinguished; delivered percept SHA256 must match across controllers/trials for each fixture/decision; native mind situation reports internally inferred own state

resourceFormula.controllerHours: C=[3681280*(meanWallMs param + meanWallMs selected2x + meanWallMs selected4x)+3454464*meanWallMs mind]/3600000
resourceFormula.interpretation: Declared3x multiplier plus2-hour reserve for simulator/opponents/serialization etc, NOT measured/certifiedCPU. No posthoc formula changes.
